title: typing forms
src:
from typing import NamedTuple, Protocol, Generic, TypeVar, Annotated, Optional
class P(NamedTuple):
    x: int
    y: float = 1.5
print(P(1), P(1)._asdict(), P(1).y, P._fields)
T = TypeVar('T')
print(T)
class Box(Generic[T]):
    def __init__(self, v: T):
        self.v = v
print(Box[int](3).v, Box(4).v)
class Q(Protocol):
    def f(self) -> int: ...
class R:
    def f(self): return 1
print(R().f())
def g(a: Annotated[int, 'x'], b: Optional[str] = None): return a
print(g(1))

title: numpy forms
src:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
print(np.full_like(x, x), np.full_like(x, 7), np.full_like(x, [1, 2]))
print(np.hstack(x), np.vstack(x), np.concatenate(x), np.stack(x), np.column_stack(x), np.dstack(x).shape)

print(np.permute_dims(x), np.matrix_transpose(x))
print(np.finfo(float).eps, np.finfo(0.5).bits, np.iinfo(np.int32).max, np.finfo(np.float32).eps)
print(np.finfo(np.float64))
print(np.iinfo(np.int64))
g = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(5))
print(type(g).__name__, g.random(2).shape, type(np.random.PCG64(5)).__name__, type(np.random.MT19937(5)).__name__, np.random.SeedSequence(5))
print(np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence(5)).random(1).shape)
print(np.ndarray((2, 2)).shape, np.ndarray((2,), dtype=int).dtype)
print(np.random.random_integers(1, size=2))

title: torch forms
src:
import torch, torch.nn as nn, torch.nn.functional as F
t = torch.tensor([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
print(F.hinge_embedding_loss(t, torch.tensor([[1., -1.], [1., -1.]])), F.hinge_embedding_loss(t, t), torch.hinge_embedding_loss(t, t))
print(F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(t, t), torch.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(t, t))
print(torch.cholesky_inverse(torch.tensor([[2., 0.], [1., 3.]])), torch.cholesky_inverse(torch.tensor([[2., 1.], [0., 3.]]), upper=True))
print(torch.histogram(t).hist.shape, torch.histogram(t, 2), torch.histogram(t, bins=torch.tensor([0., 2., 5.])))
print(torch.ones(2).bernoulli(1.0), torch.ones(2).bernoulli(0.0), torch.bernoulli(t, 1.0), torch.bernoulli(torch.ones(2)), F.alpha_dropout(t), F.feature_alpha_dropout(t), F.alpha_dropout(t, training=True).shape, F.dropout(t).shape)
print(torch.rrelu_(t.clone()), nn.Buffer(), nn.Buffer(torch.ones(1)), F.rrelu(t))

title: keras star unpacking
src:
from keras import Sequential, Input
from keras.layers import Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, Dense

block = lambda: [Conv2D(10, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
                 Conv2D(10, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
                 MaxPooling2D(2)]
model = Sequential([Input((32, 32, 3)), *block(), *block(), *block(),
                    Flatten(), Dense(10, activation='softmax')])
model.summary()
